The pre-operative sequence of chemotherapy -\> chemoradiotherapy (arm A) has been shown to be feasible with no early tumor progression prior to definitive surgical resection in a small randomized phase II study from Spain. The sequence chemoradiotherapy -\> chemotherapy (arm B) may be beneficial according to response kinetics considerations, and by maintaining a highly effective local treatment in the first place.
